description: Machine-checkable inventory of the pre-commit enforcement suite. Mirrors each module's GATE_DEFS; a unit test enforces the match.

gates.description: no eval/exec calls, os.system, subprocess shell mode, pickle deserialization, or unsafe yaml loading in added lines
gates.name: dangerous-calls

gates.description: no bare except clauses in added Python lines (name the exception)
gates.name: bare-except

gates.description: new def/class in code dirs needs a test file in the same diff
gates.name: tests-with-code

gates.description: no raw-file CDN fetches: all GitHub reads go through api.github.com
gates.name: no-raw-github

gates.description: no local pushes in scripts: GitHub is API-only
gates.name: no-git-push

gates.description: video files never go in git
gates.name: no-video

gates.description: committed PDFs are the single combined <name>-documentation.pdf
gates.name: pdf-naming

gates.description: new markdown under docs/ belongs under docs/technical/
gates.name: docs-home

gates.description: key-looking content in added lines: AWS key IDs, PEM headers, credential assignments with quoted values
gates.name: secrets

gates.description: credential values must never be printed or logged
gates.name: token-in-log
